description: Look up KISCON construction-firm disclosure rows (data.go.kr 15061362 ConAdminInfoSvc1/GongsiReg). Upstream requires sDate/eDate (not bizno); server scans the window and matches the registration number, with an optional company-name fallback when the source row has no registration number. Empty matches mean no hit in this window — not a certified clean claim. Platform service key only — no account_link_id.

bizno.description: Business registration number, 10 digits. Matched against response ncrMasterNum after window scan.

corp_name.description: Optional firm name for M2/M3-style fallback when source ncrMasterNum is blank.

eDate.description: Gongsi period end YYYYMMDD (required by upstream).

maxPages.description: Max upstream pages to scan (default 5, hard max 20).

sDate.description: Gongsi period begin YYYYMMDD (required by upstream).
